description: Asrai Chain Screener (asrai.me/chain-screener): NEW on-chain tokens (Solana, Base, BNB Chain, Robinhood… chains picked by activity) that passed the safety checks, re-checked every 15 min. tab: 'hot' = 🟢 alive (safe, 6 h+ old, under $50M, holders growing, buyers ahead), 'fresh' = safe and under a day old, 'safe' (default) = all 🟢/🟡, 'traps' = tokens that failed a check in the last 24 h (with why). 'alive' is Asrai's rule, not yet backtested — present it as a safety-filtered list, never as picks. Very high risk. For one token use token_check.
